highlights: The focus is 'Gunsan Malt' craft beer, made from 100% Gunsan barley. Taking part: 4 Gunsan breweries and 6 local beer makers that use Gunsan Malt. There are also 6 beers from overseas partner cities: Yantai and Qingdao (China), Takamatsu and Kagoshima (Japan), New Taipei (Taiwan) and Tacoma (US).
16 blues bands, including Kang San-e Band, Kim Jong-seo Band, Kim Gyeong-ho Band and Sinchon Blues.
About 30 Gunsan restaurant booths and 5,000 table seats.
You get beer in exchange for beer vouchers (bought by card or cash) or 5,000 won Gunsan Love Gift Certificates.
Pets may enter in a cage or a stroller.
19 public and temporary parking lots nearby (140 spaces in front of Jinpo Marine Park, 140 at the former police station, 105 under Dongbaek Bridge, and more).
About 40 temporary Culture Nuri Card merchants.
